# NyayaSetu — iOS Deployment Checklist
# Generated by Qoder for ravikiranmentorites@gmail.com

## Prerequisites (one-time setup)
- [ ] macOS with Xcode 15+ installed
- [ ] Ruby 3.x: `brew install ruby`
- [ ] Bundler: `gem install bundler`
- [ ] CocoaPods: `gem install cocoapods`
- [ ] Flutter SDK: https://docs.flutter.dev/get-started/install/macos

## Step 1 — Firebase setup (one-time)
1. Go to console.firebase.google.com
2. Create project "nyayasetu"
3. Add iOS app with bundle ID: com.ravikiran.nyayasetu
4. Download GoogleService-Info.plist
5. Copy it to: nyayasetu/flutter_app/ios/Runner/GoogleService-Info.plist
6. In the Flutter folder run:
   flutterfire configure
   (This updates lib/firebase_options.dart automatically)

## Step 2 — Update API URL
Open: nyayasetu/flutter_app/lib/core/constants.dart
Change kApiBaseUrl to your deployed Spring Boot URL.
For local testing use: http://localhost:8080/api

## Step 3 — Install dependencies
cd nyayasetu/flutter_app
flutter pub get
cd ios && pod install && cd ..
bundle install

## Step 4 — First time: create app on App Store Connect
bundle exec fastlane create_app
(Enter your Apple ID password + 2FA code when prompted)
This creates com.ravikiran.nyayasetu on App Store Connect.

## Step 5 — Deploy to TestFlight (test first)
bundle exec fastlane beta
- Fastlane will ask for your Apple ID password
- Your iPhone will show a 2FA code — enter it
- It builds the app, signs it, uploads to TestFlight (~10 min)
- You get an email when it's ready to test

## Step 6 — Submit to App Store
bundle exec fastlane release
- Same as above but submits for Apple review
- Apple review takes 1–3 days for first submission

## Troubleshooting

### "No signing certificate found"
  Run: bundle exec fastlane match init
  Choose "appstore", enter your Apple ID
  This sets up certificate storage in iCloud/Git

### "Bundle identifier already taken"
  Change bundle ID in:
  - fastlane/Appfile (app_identifier line)
  - fastlane/Fastfile (all occurrences)
  - ios/Runner/Info.plist (CFBundleIdentifier)
  Try: com.ravikiran.nyayasetu2 or com.mentorites.nyayasetu

### "Team name mismatch"
  Open App Store Connect → find your exact team name
  Update in fastlane/Appfile: itc_team_name and team_name

### Flutter build fails
  flutter clean && flutter pub get
  cd ios && pod deintegrate && pod install && cd ..

## Lane reference
  fastlane create_app   — register app on App Store Connect (run once)
  fastlane beta         — build + upload to TestFlight
  fastlane release      — build + submit to App Store review
  fastlane add_device   — register a test device UDID
